errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse ist mit „Angaben in Euro pro Stunde“ beschriftet
errors.evidence: The vertical axis has no label. The phrase 'Angaben in Euro pro Stunde' is part of the chart's main title, not an axis label.

errors.text_span: einen hellvioletten Balken, der den gesetzlichen Mindestlohn darstellt
errors.evidence: The bar representing the statutory minimum wage ('Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn') is light blue, not light purple ('hellvioletten').

errors.text_span: Der gesetzliche Mindestlohn beträgt 2015 8,50 €, steigt dann auf 10,59 €, 10,82 €, 10,92 €, 9,19 €, 9,35 €, 12,00 €, 12,80 €, 13,12 €, 13,93 €, 14,69 € und schließlich 15,12 € im Jahr 2025.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly lists values for the 'Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn' (statutory minimum wage). After the correct starting value of 8,50 €, the description lists a jumbled mix of values, many of which belong to the other series ('60 % des Medianlohns') or are attributed to the wrong years.

errors.text_span: 60 % des Medianlohns von Vollzeitbeschäftigten beginnen bei 8,50 € im Jahr 2015
errors.evidence: The value for '60 % des Medianlohns' in 2015 is 10,59 €, not 8,50 €. The value 8,50 € belongs to the 'Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn' series.
The values 12,41 € and 12,82 € belong to the 'Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn' series for the years 2024 and 2025, respectively, not the '60 % des Medianlohns' series.

The description fails to mention that the bars for the years 2024 and 2025 have a distinct diagonal hatching pattern, which visually distinguishes them from the other years and likely indicates projected or provisional data.
